column1: # The provincial communications administrations' five-year plans for the information and communications industry (for 2026 to 2030, and the ones before them, for 2021 to 2025), searched as a class on Nov 25, 2026 for a home-made share of computing, chips or equipment: 30 rows, one for each provincial-level unit other than Zhejiang, whose plan holds the share that prompted the search. group says what could be read: the plan for 2026 to 2030 in full for 10 units (Shanghai's and Shandong's in trade sites' copies, the administrations' own PDFs being scans), as a consultation draft for 2, only the plan for 2021 to 2025 for 7, and no plan text for 11 (releases or accounts only). No text read states a percentage for home-made computing, chips or equipment. How read: every passage with 国产, 自主可控, 信创 or 芯片 read in its context, and every percentage checked by script for a home-made word beside it, over the whole text of each saved copy (for pages saved as HTML, over the raw page too, so that tables count); the same check finds the 60% of Zhejiang's plan (the control). A plan "sets a share" only if its own text states a percentage. Not a census of what the administrations issued: eleven plans' texts were not found.
